description: The pie chart represents the distribution of languages in the OpenAssistant Conversations dataset. The chart is divided into 9 slices, with the largest slice labeled "English" in dark blue, accounting for approximately 57% of the total. The second-largest slice is "Spanish" in blue, making up around 31.4%. The remaining slices are "Russian" in light blue (5.7%), "German" in pale blue (3.6%), "French" in very pale blue (2.9%), "Chinese" in light gray-blue (2.5%), "Thai" in gray-blue (1.9%), "Portuguese (Brazil)" in light gray (1.7%), and "Catalan" in very light gray (1.6%), with the last slice labeled "Other" in white, comprising 5.8%. The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, and the slices are arranged in descending order of size.
